Trigger A firearm you are wielding gains the Jammed condition.

Immediately clear the weapon and reload it, both as part of the triggering event and at no action cost. This has no frequency limit — a Gun Failure is its own trigger, and failures are not something you choose to suffer. Each one also banks a Trick Iron charge as normal, so the round the gun betrays you is the round you gain on it.
